Contain a compromised test account

This synthetic article describes how to contain a test account. See the overview.

Prerequisites

  • An account with the Example Admin role.
  • The Example.Module PowerShell module.

Steps

  1. Disable the account.

    Disable-ExampleAccount -Identity testuser

  2. Revoke sessions.

    Warning

    Revoking sessions signs the user out of every device.

    Revoke-ExampleSession -UserId testuser -All

Note

Sessions end within one hour.

Verify revocation

Check the sign-in log for new sessions.

SignalMeaning
New sign-inRevocation incomplete
